shellCommands.command: ls -la && git show --stat HEAD && cat package.json 2>/dev/null; node --version; head -c 600 package-lock.json

python3 - <<'EOF'
import json
p=json.load(open('package.json'))
p['scripts']={'start':'node server.js','test':'vitest run', **{k:v for k,v in p['scripts'].items() if k=='build'}}
json.dump(p,open('package.json','w'),indent=2); open('package.json','a').write('\n')
EOF
printf 'data/\n' >> .gitignore
cat package.json .gitignore; npx vitest run 2>&1 | tail -25

cd /tmp && rm -rf smoke && mkdir smoke && (PORT=3999 DATA_FILE=/tmp/smoke/books.json node /workspace/server.js & echo $! > /tmp/smoke/pid); sleep 0.7
curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code} %{redirect_url}\n' -d 'title=Middlemarch&author=George Eliot&notes=Slow start, worth it' http://127.0.0.1:3999/books
cat /tmp/smoke/books.json; id=$(node -e 'console.log(require("/tmp/smoke/books.json").books[0].id)')
curl -s http://127.0.0.1:3999/books/$id | sed -n '/<h2>/,$p'
kill $(cat /tmp/smoke/pid)
